# Blueprint Generator

> AI-Powered Project Architecture Documentation - Generate production-ready blueprint.md and task.md files for your projects in seconds.

## About

Blueprint Generator is a web application that helps developers and architects create comprehensive project documentation using AI. Built with Cloudflare Workers + React.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://blueprintify.dev) - Main application entry point
- [API Documentation](https://blueprintify.dev/api) - REST API reference
- [User Guide](https://blueprintify.dev/docs/user-guide) - Complete usage guide
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/cpa03/blueprintify) - Source code and issue tracking

## Features

- Wizard Interface: Step-by-step project configuration
- Template Library: Pre-configured project templates
- Real-time Streaming: SSE-based AI generation
- Split-Pane Editor: CodeMirror with live markdown preview
- One-Click Export: Download as ZIP/JSON/Markdown
- Auto-Save: Session persistence with localStorage
- Dark Mode: Premium dark UI with glassmorphism effects

## Tech Stack

- Frontend: React 19, Vite 8, Tailwind CSS 3, TypeScript 6
- Backend: Hono, Cloudflare Workers
- State: Zustand
- Editing: CodeMirror
- AI: OpenAI SDK

## API Endpoints

- GET / - Health check
- GET /warmup - Pre-warm circuit breaker on worker startup
- POST /generate - Generate blueprint (SSE stream)
- POST /tasks - Generate tasks from blueprint (SSE stream)
- POST /refine - Refine content section (SSE stream)
- POST /export - Export project as ZIP/JSON/Markdown
- POST /import - Import project with validation
- GET /storage/quota - Check storage usage
- POST /storage/report - Report client storage usage for quota tracking
- DELETE /storage/clear - Clear stored data
- POST /share - Create shareable blueprint link
- GET /share/:id - Retrieve shared blueprint
- POST /share/:id/verify - Verify passphrase for protected shared blueprint
- DELETE /share/:id - Delete shared blueprint
